shortDescription: Create, update or remove a group.

options.description: Privilege for a group to access and manage certificates.

options.name: access_and_manage_monitoring
options.description: Privilege for a group to access and manage monitoring related functionality (access metrics, CRUD on alarms, alarm-actions etc) using Monotoring-as-a-Service (MaaS).

options.name: api_url
options.description: The Ionos API base URL.

options.name: certificate_fingerprint
options.description: The Ionos API certificate fingerprint.

options.name: create_backup_unit
options.description: Create backup unit privilege.

options.name: create_datacenter
options.description: Create data center privilege.

options.name: create_flow_log
options.description: Create Flow Logs privilege.

options.name: create_internet_access
options.description: Create internet access privilege.

options.name: create_k8s_cluster
options.description: Create Kubernetes cluster privilege.

options.name: create_pcc
options.description: User privilege to create a cross connect.

options.name: create_snapshot
options.description: Create snapshot privilege.

options.name: group
options.description: The ID or name of the group.

options.name: manage_dbaas
options.description: Privilege for a group to manage DBaaS related functionality.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the resource.

options.name: password
options.description: The Ionos password. Overrides the IONOS_PASSWORD environment variable.

options.name: reserve_ip
options.description: Reserve IP block privilege.

options.name: s3_privilege
options.description: S3 privilege.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the resource.

options.name: token
options.description: The Ionos token. Overrides the IONOS_TOKEN environment variable.

options.name: username
options.description: The Ionos username. Overrides the IONOS_USERNAME environment variable.

options.name: users
options.description: A list of (non-administrator) user IDs or emails to associate with the group. Set to empty list ([]) to remove all users from the group.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the resource to be created before returning.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: How long before wait gives up, in seconds.
